name: Plan Liaoning CV-16
description: Liaoning aircraft carrier: referred to as "Liaoning ship", named after the place where it was refitted, it is China's first aircraft carrier. The official handover and commissioning on September 5, 2015 marked my country's breakthrough in achieving "zero" aircraft carriers. It is of great significance for improving the modernization level of the Chinese Navy's comprehensive combat forces, enhancing its defense combat capabilities, developing long-sea cooperation and responding to non-traditional security threats, effectively safeguarding national sovereignty, security and development interests, and promoting world peace and common development.
